title: Supervisor state (supervisor/<profile_id>.json)
description: Active holds plus dedupe/hysteresis memory and a bounded ledger (ADR-0005/0008, P06). Written only by the daemon's supervisor engine, before any pause/resume command is sent.

holds.description: Active holds. A session is paused while at least one applicable hold is active.

paused_instances.description: Window instances that already paused once (hysteresis), newest 500.

released_instances.description: Instances released by a manual resume or a time-based clear; they never pause again.

extra_usage_arm.description: Arm counter of the `extra_usage` window instance; bumped when percent drops below warn (ADR-0022). Missing means 0.

instance.description: Window-instance key: `session:<YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ>`, `weekly:<K>`, `model_scoped:<Name>:<K>`, `extra_usage:<cap>:<arm>` (legacy `extra_usage:<YYYY-MM>:<cap>` is upgraded to arm 0 on load, ADR-0022), `manual:<ts>` or `manual:<wrapper_id>:<ts>`.

scope.description: Model name (model_scoped) or wrapper id (session-scoped manual hold); null = whole profile.
